about_the_game:
A dark force is corrupting the land. Elemental creatures are losing control. You must master the art of battle, forge the most powerful weapons, and recruit legendary allies to halt Ogre Muk’s reign of terror. Will you rise as a hero, or let it fall into darkness?

Chronicles of Veldoria is a tactical RPG that redefines classic turn-based combat with its Press Turn battle system. Learn to exploit enemy weaknesses, merge with elemental spirits, and upgrade powerful skills to dominate the battlefield. Every attack matters.

                                    

                      Two childhood friends. A world in chaos. A tyrant rising.

Choose between Alex, the charismatic warrior, or Elizabeth, the kind-hearted mage, and embark on a quest across six vast regions, each guarded by corrupted elemental bosses under the influence of the dark tyrant, Ogre Muk.

Once you’ve chosen, you’ll battle these legendary creatures and uncover ancient secrets to strike a decisive blow against Muk’s sinister plans. You won’t be alone, however. You’ll encounter brave heroes who will join your cause against tyranny and many citizens worldwide looking to lend a hand.

                                                              Key Features

                          Press Turn Battle System – Master Tactical Combat

Press Turn is a deep, strategic battle system where every action carries weight. Prepare for intense, tactical encounters where skillful play is rewarded, and mistakes can be punishing:

  • Exploit enemy weaknesses or land critical hits to earn extra turns and turn the tables

  • Missing an attack doesn’t just waste your move—it costs your team an additional turn!

  • Use your skills wisely, as each ability consumes only a single turn, demanding careful planning in every battle.

         Convince Enemies to Join You & Merge with Weapons, Armor, or Allies

Pure weapons provide a modest stat boost, but diving into side quests will allow you to recruit unique monsters to your party. Once allied, these creatures can merge with weapons, armor, or even your teammates, granting substantial stat boosts, unique traits, and powerful new skills.

🎮 Downloaded the demo? Jump in now and experience the adventure!

📝 Your feedback helps shape the game—be part of the journey!

⭐ Wishlist Chronicles of Veldoria today to be the first to play the full Early Access release!
detailed_description:
Feature List

✅ Press Turn Battle System- Use strategic, turn-based tactics to win battles!

✅ Monster fusion- Recruit monsters and have them merge with your party members, weapons, and armor!

✅ No Random Encounters – See enemies on the world map and strategize your fights.

✅ Animated Enemies – Every battle comes alive with smooth enemy animations.

✅ Job Point System – Upgrade your skills and build an epic squad of characters.

✅ Deep side quests – Earn extra rewards and meeting interesting characters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10/11 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card

short_description: Chronicles of Veldoria is an epic tactical RPG where you’ll meet new allies, convince monsters to join you, do monster fusion, craft items, learn & upgrade skills, and gather strength to battle the malignant forces of an ancient evil, Ogre Muk, to save the majestic land of Veldoria!
